column6: RischNotImplemented: a nested radical whose conjugate pieces √(2a ± 2is) are not square roots of quadratics

RischNotImplemented: the residues are algebraic constants of degree ≥ 2 over the constant field RischIntegrate.Frac{RischIntegrate.UPoly{RischIntegrate.QI}} (RootSum inside towers is implemented over ℚ and ℚ(i) only)
NotElementary: no elementary antiderivative: the Risch differential equation y' + 1·u'·y = a has no solution in the coefficient field, so the coefficient of exp(u)^1 has no elementary integral
NotElementary: no elementary antiderivative: the Risch differential equation y' + -1·u'·y = a has no solution in the coefficient field, so the coefficient of exp(u)^-1 has no elementary integral
